title: Antique Brass Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Double Wall-Mounted Shelf W/ Gallery Rail, Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
description: Glass shelf for bathroom storage, 16 inches / 16-inch / 16in double wall-mount shelf with gallery rail and 3/8-in (0.38 in) tempered glass — available in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This wall-mounted glass shelf acts as a bathroom shelf, wall shelf, and floating shelf alternative for holding toiletries while saving counter space. Two-tier double shelf design; gallery rail keeps items in place. Solid brass hardware with concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished appearance. Dimensions: 16 in length x 5 in depth/projection x 8 in height; glass dimensions 16 x 5 inches. Weight capacity 4 lb. Includes glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4. Transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware styling, part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place pieces and grooved bathroom hardware coordination. Lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Waverly Place collection.
